prompt: Use case: compositing / text-localization. Create a NEW home event promotional banner derived from IMAGE 1, the November Kyoto maple-tree bridge background. No new characters or Halloween objects. Add subtle dark translucent warm-brown backing only behind text for excellent contrast with the colorful foliage. Thin gold pixel-art outer border. Below the title, smaller white bold Japanese exact text on two lines 「タスクを達成して」 then 「限定アイテムを手に入れよう！」, comfortably legible at mobile banner scale. In the lower-right (roughly x73%-98%, y65%-91%), a dark red/vermillion plaque with a light gold/cream outline containing large white exact text 「イベントへ ›」, like reference 2's button but in November colors. Leave plenty of padding for all letters; no title overlap with button. Do not bake in '開催中', dates, remaining days, or login counts, since those are rendered live by the app. Preserve crisp warm pixel-art style in all scenery, clean bold Japanese type with dark outline like reference2; no handwriting, no watermark, no extra text. Return only the final finished wide banner.
